text:
Aisha: Heads-up — saw a ~0.7% delta between invoice-preview and final invoices for a subset of tenants that hit region-fallback to Dedicated during bursts. Suspect duplicate billing events when pricing overrides are applied late in the finalizer. :eyes:
Ben: Can you paste an example pair of events and the req_id?
Aisha: Here's a minimal sample (same req_id emitted twice, once by router and once by finalizer after price calc):
```json
{"req_id":"r-92f3","tenant":"acme","route":"hosted","route_resolution_id":"rr-11","tokens":120}
{"req_id":"r-92f3","tenant":"acme","route":"dedicated","route_resolution_id":"rr-11","tokens":120,"price_override":{"unit":"token","price":0.0009}}
```
Ravi: If finalizer emits a new event instead of updating the original, we double-count. Dedupe by req_id alone is dangerous (retries). Need canonical key = req_id + route_resolution_id + billing_phase.
Marta: Finance flagged customers seeing preview != invoice. Console preview shows hosted line, invoice shows dedicated price — confusing for users.
Isaac: Latency note: any extra joins on the hot path (to look up route_resolution_id) might regress p50. Keep it lightweight.
Leah: Proposed approach: 1) add `billing_provenance` and `preview` flags at router; 2) finalizer should upsert (not append) into a compacted topic keyed by canonical billing key; 3) only emit final invoice_event when record transitions to `finalized=true`. Upsert key = tenant|req_id|route_resolution_id|session_epoch.
Ben: Upsert in Kafka stream is ok if we use a compacted topic + finalizer writes final record. Consumer that builds invoices reads from compacted topic so duplicates collapse. Need schema contract for canonical key.
Aisha: Lightweight alternative: router emits preview event (preview=true) and finalizer emits a delta that references the preview id; finalizer emits an `overwrite=true` event that should replace preview in invoice preview. But that still requires preview consumers to understand overwrite semantics.
Ravi: Also consider short-lived dedupe layer (bloom filter) at finalizer for the very hot burst cases (30s TTL). Bloom reduces coordination but has fp risk — we can tune size.
Ben: I'm wary of false positives in accounting. Prefer compacted topic with explicit upsert semantics + small in-memory cache for immediate duplicates.
Marta: UX ask: Console invoice-preview should surface `provenance` column (preview/router/finalizer) and highlight rows that are pending finalization. Add a tooltip explaining price overrides for Dedicated vs Hosted. Finance will need a note in exported CSV for this rollout.
Isaac: Metrics: track `preview_to_final_delta` per tenant (tokens and $), and alert if mean delta >0.2% over 1h. Also monitor finalizer error rate and pipeline consumer lag.
Leah: Rollout plan suggestion: feature flag in finalizer; canary 1% tenants -> 10% -> 100%. Add dashboard and alert before each ramp. Also add end-to-end test in staging that replays mixed fallback scenarios. :shipit:
Ravi: Migration question: for in-flight duplicates that already landed in invoice preview topic, we need a reconciliation job to collapse by canonical key for the last 48h and emit corrections.
Aisha: I'll open the reconciliation ticket and attach bisect artifacts + sample tenant ids. LINK: https://go/recon/INV-847
Ben: Action list from infra side: define canonical key schema (Ben), implement compacted topic consumer (Ben + Leah), add small dedupe cache (Ravi), update finalizer to write `finalized=true` (Leah).
Marta: I'll coordinate finance comms and update console UX mock for provenance column.
Isaac: I'll add Grafana panels and the `preview_vs_final_delta` alert rule.
Leah: I'll own rollout. I'll start a PR today for the topic + schema. Planning deploy window tomorrow 09:30 PT.
deploy-bot: prod-deploy/finalizer v2.4.1 started by @Leah — canary rollout to 1% (traffic split).
Leah: Ping me if you want to join the deploy window. I'll post the PR link and metrics dash once ready.
Aisha: Thanks all — this should cut the invoice noise and make preview vs final consistent. I'll follow up with the reconciliation scope in the ticket. :+1:
